item.text: I’m checking for remaining design debt before changing anything again. The main candidates now are immutability boundaries and duplicated validation patterns across the new model types.

The public API is now coherent: callers can actually construct graphs and inspect results without relying on package-private internals. I’m adding a compatibility test next so both the typed API and the legacy sentinel path stay covered.
The API cleanup and extra coverage are in place. I’m compiling and running the full set now to make sure the accessor changes and added legacy-path tests all hold up.
